description: Scheduled amount of a ranged schedule: the single amount a schedule with a ranged (and, from T3, approximate) amount is expected to post.

f_comment_fact.fact: F's getScheduledAmount / template comments: the budget template rounds a range as halfOfRoundedSum, the other callers as roundedMidpoint, and why the half unit is harmless after the adjustment (visible but uncommented in R).
f_comment_fact.basis: From T1 on no consumer resolves a range to its midpoint: every tested value is a range end (T1, T4) or an approximate value's tolerance end, rounded to the cent as the T3 statement states, so no expected value depends on either midpoint rounding mode.
f_comment_fact.rule: Per step, depends_on_f_comment_fact is true when the step's hidden tests depend on a fact stated only in F's doc comments (docs/study2-refactor-review-independent.md, 'Do F's doc comments give F an unfair advantage?'); decided by reading the hidden tests, before any pilot run (spec amendment 2026-10-08, item 10).
